lastResponse.text: I’m here with you, and you did the right thing asking for live support. Let’s connect now: call or text 9-8-8 right now, and I’ll stay with you while you do it. If you feel like you might act on these thoughts at any moment, call nine one one immediately. Take one slow breath with me, then open your phone and dial 9-8-8.
